```{r}
N172010 <- read_csv("Data/N172010-1.csv") %>%
  filter(`Year Code` < 2018)
N172018 <- read_csv("Data/N172018-1.csv")
clean_year <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Year_raw = as.character(Year),
      # pull the first 4-digit year (e.g., "2024 (provisional)" -> 2024)
      Year = readr::parse_number(Year_raw),
      # keep any extra text as a note (optional)
      Year_note = str_squish(str_remove(Year_raw, "^\\d{4}"))
    )
}

N17 <- bind_rows(
  clean_year(N172010 ),
  clean_year(N172018 )
) %>%
  select(-Year_raw)

glimpse(N17)
```

```{r}
std2000_allages <- tibble(
  age_code = c(
    "1","1-4",
    "5-9","10-14",
    "15-19","20-24",
    "25-29","30-34",
    "35-39","40-44",
    "45-49","50-54",
    "55-59","60-64",
    "65-69","70-74",
    "75-79","80-84",
    "85+"
  ),
  std_million = c(
    13818, 55317,
    145565/2, 145565/2,
    138646/2, 138646/2,
    135573/2, 135573/2,
    162613/2, 162613/2,
    134834/2, 134834/2,
    87247/2,  87247/2,
    66037/2,  66037/2,
    44842/2,  44842/2,
    15508
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    std_million = round(std_million),
    weight = std_million / sum(std_million)
  )

# ---- collapse detailed elderly bins to "85+" for standardization ----
recode_to_std_age <- function(age_code) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    age_code %in% c("85-89", "90-94", "95-99", "100+") ~ "85+",
    TRUE ~ age_code
  )
}

# ---- mapping to 4 broad age bands ----
age_group_map <- list(
  "<20"   = c("1","1-4","5-9","10-14","15-19"),
  "20–44" = c("20-24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44"),
  "45–64" = c("45-49","50-54","55-59","60-64"),
  "65+"   = c("65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85-89","90-94","95-99","100+","85+")
)

# ✅ IMPORTANT: joinable map used by AAMR functions
age_band_map <- tibble(
  age_code = std2000_allages$age_code,
  age4 = case_when(
    age_code %in% age_group_map[["<20"]]   ~ "<20",
    age_code %in% age_group_map[["20–44"]] ~ "20_44",
    age_code %in% age_group_map[["45–64"]] ~ "45_64",
    age_code %in% age_group_map[["65+"]]   ~ "65+",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age4))

# ---- safe numeric parsing for Population ("Not Applicable" -> NA) ----
parse_pop_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if(as.character(x), "Not Applicable")
  readr::parse_number(x, na = c("", "NA", "Not Applicable"))
}

# ============================================================
# Core: compute within-band AAMR by Year Code (YearKey)
# (weights re-normalized within each band)
# ============================================================
calc_band_aamr_by_yearcode <- function(df, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      YearCode = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      YearKey  = as.character(YearCode),
      Deaths   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code_raw = `Five-Year Age Groups Code`,
      age_code = recode_to_std_age(age_code_raw)
    ) %>%
    filter(YearCode >= year_min, YearCode <= year_max) %>%
    filter(age_code %in% std2000_allages$age_code) %>%
    left_join(age_band_map, by = "age_code") %>%
    filter(!is.na(age4)) %>%
    group_by(YearKey, age4, age_code) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(std2000_allages, by = "age_code") %>%
    group_by(YearKey, age4) %>%
    mutate(
      w_band   = weight / sum(weight),
      age_rate = ifelse(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR_band = sum(age_rate * w_band, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      YearKey = as.character(year_min:year_max),
      age4 = c("<20", "20_44", "45_64", "65+"),
      fill = list(AAMR_band = NA_real_)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Total row for within-band AAMR (YearKey = "Total")
# ============================================================
calc_band_aamr_total_yearcode <- function(df, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      YearCode = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Deaths   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code_raw = `Five-Year Age Groups Code`,
      age_code = recode_to_std_age(age_code_raw)
    ) %>%
    filter(YearCode >= year_min, YearCode <= year_max) %>%
    filter(age_code %in% std2000_allages$age_code) %>%
    left_join(age_band_map, by = "age_code") %>%
    filter(!is.na(age4)) %>%
    group_by(age4, age_code) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(std2000_allages, by = "age_code") %>%
    group_by(age4) %>%
    mutate(
      w_band   = weight / sum(weight),
      age_rate = ifelse(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      YearKey = "Total",
      AAMR_band = sum(age_rate * w_band, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Final: deaths by band + within-band AAMR by YearKey + Total
# Returns list(deaths = ..., rates = ...)
# ============================================================
year_age_deaths_band_aamr <- function(df, prefix, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  # ---- deaths by bands (YearKey) ----
  by_year_age <- df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      YearCode = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      YearKey  = as.character(YearCode),
      Deaths   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      age_code_raw = `Five-Year Age Groups Code`,
      age_code = recode_to_std_age(age_code_raw),
      age4 = case_when(
        age_code %in% age_group_map[["<20"]]   ~ "<20",
        age_code %in% age_group_map[["20–44"]] ~ "20_44",
        age_code %in% age_group_map[["45–64"]] ~ "45_64",
        age_code %in% age_group_map[["65+"]]   ~ "65+",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(YearCode >= year_min, YearCode <= year_max, !is.na(age4)) %>%
    group_by(YearKey, age4) %>%
    summarise(deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(
      YearKey = as.character(year_min:year_max),
      age4 = c("<20", "20_44", "45_64", "65+"),
      fill = list(deaths = 0)
    )

  total_deaths_rows <- by_year_age %>%
    group_by(age4) %>%
    summarise(YearKey = "Total", deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  deaths_wide <- bind_rows(by_year_age, total_deaths_rows) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = age4, values_from = deaths, values_fill = 0) %>%
    rename(
      !!paste0(prefix, "_deaths_lt20")     := `<20`,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_deaths_20_44")    := `20_44`,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_deaths_45_64")    := `45_64`,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_deaths_65_plus")  := `65+`
    )

  # ---- within-band AAMR by YearKey + Total ----
  aamr_year  <- calc_band_aamr_by_yearcode(df, year_min, year_max)
  aamr_total <- calc_band_aamr_total_yearcode(df, year_min, year_max)
  aamr_all   <- bind_rows(aamr_year, aamr_total)

  rates_wide <- aamr_all %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = age4, values_from = AAMR_band) %>%
    rename(
      !!paste0(prefix, "_<20")   := `<20`,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_20_44") := `20_44`,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_45_64") := `45_64`,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_65+")   := `65+`)

  list(deaths = deaths_wide, rates = rates_wide)
}
```

```{r}

# ---- Build for the 3 datasets ----
arf   <- year_age_deaths_band_aamr(N17, "AKI")
sepsis  <- year_age_deaths_band_aamr(A40, "Sepsis")
both <- year_age_deaths_band_aamr(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis")

# ---- Combine into one deaths table ----
deaths_table_age <- arf$deaths %>%
  full_join(sepsis$deaths, by = "YearKey") %>%
  full_join(both$deaths,   by = "YearKey") %>%
  mutate(YearKey = factor(YearKey, levels = c(as.character(2010:2025), "Total"))) %>%
  arrange(YearKey)

# ---- Combine into one crude-rate table ----
rate_table_age <- arf$rates %>%
  full_join(sepsis$rates, by = "YearKey") %>%
  full_join(both$rates,   by = "YearKey") %>%
  mutate(YearKey = factor(YearKey, levels = c(as.character(2010:2025), "Total"))) %>%
  arrange(YearKey) %>%
  # Optional: round rates nicely
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

deaths_table_age
rate_table_age
```

```{r}
apc_yearly_from_aamr <- rate_table_age %>%
  mutate(
    Year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(YearKey)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 2010, Year <= 2025) %>%   # drop "Total"
  select(Year, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Year,
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "AAMR"
  ) %>%
  # defensive: keep only AAMR-like columns (no deaths)
  filter(!str_detect(series, "_deaths_")) %>%
  mutate(
    series = str_trim(series),

    # ---- Detect outcome robustly (handles slash OR underscore naming) ----
    outcome = case_when(
      str_starts(series, "AKI/sepsis_") ~ "AKI/sepsis",
      str_starts(series, "AKI_Sepsis_") ~ "AKI/sepsis",
      str_starts(series, "Sepsis_")     ~ "Sepsis",
      str_starts(series, "AKI_")        ~ "AKI",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ---- Remove the detected prefix to isolate the age token ----
    age_token = case_when(
      str_starts(series, "AKI/sepsis_") ~ str_remove(series, "^AKI/sepsis_"),
      str_starts(series, "AKI_Sepsis_") ~ str_remove(series, "^AKI_Sepsis_"),
      str_starts(series, "Sepsis_")     ~ str_remove(series, "^Sepsis_"),
      str_starts(series, "AKI_")        ~ str_remove(series, "^AKI_"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ---- Standardize age labels ----
    age4 = recode(age_token,
      "lt20"    = "<20",
      "<20"     = "<20",
      "20_44"   = "20–44",
      "20–44"   = "20–44",
      "45_64"   = "45–64",
      "45–64"   = "45–64",
      "65_plus" = "65+",
      "65+"     = "65+"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome), !is.na(age4)) %>%
  arrange(outcome, age4, Year) %>%
  group_by(outcome, age4) %>%
  mutate(
    APC = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(lag(AAMR)) & lag(AAMR) > 0 & !is.na(AAMR),
      100 * (AAMR / lag(AAMR) - 1),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# your output
apc_yearly_from_aamr
```

```{r}
make_apc_table_one_outcome <- function(apc_df, outcome_name) {
  apc_df %>%
    filter(outcome == outcome_name, age4 %in% c("20–44", "45–64", "65+")) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.integer(Year),
      APC  = round(APC, 2)
    ) %>%
    select(Year, age4, APC) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = age4, values_from = APC) %>%
    arrange(Year)
}
```

```{r}
style_journal_table <- function(ft) {
  ft %>%
    theme_booktabs() %>%                  # clean top/mid/bottom rules; no vertical grid
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>% # within typical 10–12 pt manuscript norms :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%  # Year left-aligned like many journals
    autofit()
}
```

```{r}
# Add captions (manual numbering is safest across officer versions)

ft_sep  <- set_caption(ft_sep,  paste0("Table 2. Sepsis (A40). ", cap_common))

# Optional footnote line (AMA-style notes/abbrev under table) :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("APC tables (AAMR-based)", style = "heading 1") %>%

  body_add_flextable(ft_aki) %>%
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(flextable)
  library(officer)
  library(stringr)
})

# ---------------- settings ----------------
age_order     <- c("20–44","45–64","≥65")
outcome_order <- c("AKI","Sepsis","AKI/sepsis")

fmt2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2))

# ---------------- 1) Build a clean long table ----------------
# Use `series` to determine outcome + age (most reliable)
tab_long <- apc_yearly_from_aamr %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.character(Year),

    series = trimws(series),

    # ---- outcome from series ----
    outcome = case_when(
      str_detect(series, "^AKI_") ~ "AKI",
      str_detect(series, "^Sepsis_") ~ "Sepsis",
      str_detect(series, "^AKI[_/ ]*Sepsis_") | str_detect(series, "^AKI.*Sepsis_") ~ "AKI/sepsis",
      TRUE ~ trimws(outcome)
    ),

    # ---- age from series (preferred), fallback to age4 ----
    age4_from_series = case_when(
      str_detect(series, "_20_44$") ~ "20–44",
      str_detect(series, "_45_64$") ~ "45–64",
      str_detect(series, "_65\\+$") | str_detect(series, "_65_plus$") ~ "≥65",
      str_detect(series, "_lt20$") | str_detect(series, "_<20$") ~ "<20",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    age4_raw = trimws(age4),
    age4 = coalesce(
      age4_from_series,
      case_when(
        age4_raw %in% c("20_44", "20–44", "20-44") ~ "20–44",
        age4_raw %in% c("45_64", "45–64", "45-64") ~ "45–64",
        age4_raw %in% c("65+", "65_plus", "≥65") ~ "≥65",
        age4_raw %in% c("lt20", "<20", "< 20") ~ "<20",
        TRUE ~ age4_raw
      )
    ),

    APC = as.numeric(APC)
  ) %>%
  filter(age4 %in% age_order, outcome %in% outcome_order) %>%
  select(Year, outcome, age4, APC)

# ---- quick sanity check (prints in console) ----
message("Outcomes present after cleaning: ", paste(sort(unique(tab_long$outcome)), collapse = ", "))
message("Age groups present after cleaning: ", paste(sort(unique(tab_long$age4)), collapse = ", "))

# ---------------- 2) wide: condition blocks ----------------
tab_wide_num <- tab_long %>%
  mutate(
    age4    = factor(age4, levels = age_order),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = outcome_order)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = c(outcome, age4),
    values_from = APC,
    names_sep   = "__"
  )

# IMPORTANT:
# use any_of() so you never crash; if combined outcome truly missing, you'll see it as blank columns
need_cols <- c(
  "Year",
  paste0("AKI__", age_order),
  paste0("Sepsis__", age_order),
  paste0("AKI/sepsis__", age_order)
)

tab_wide_num <- tab_wide_num %>%
  select(any_of(need_cols))

# If the AKI/sepsis columns are still missing, create them as NA so the header build won't fail
for (nm in paste0("AKI/sepsis__", age_order)) {
  if (!nm %in% names(tab_wide_num)) tab_wide_num[[nm]] <- NA_real_
}

# Re-order columns exactly as desired
tab_wide_num <- tab_wide_num %>%
  select(
    Year,
    all_of(paste0("AKI__", age_order)),
    all_of(paste0("Sepsis__", age_order)),
    all_of(paste0("AKI/sepsis__", age_order))
  )

# --- format APC cells as text (2 decimals; NA -> dash) ---
num_cols <- setdiff(names(tab_wide_num), "Year")
tab_wide <- tab_wide_num %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), fmt2))

# ---------------- 3) flextable with 2-row header ----------------
ft <- flextable(tab_wide)

# second header row: age labels repeated under each condition
age_row <- c("Year", rep(age_order, 3))
ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = setNames(age_row, names(tab_wide)))

# top header row: group headers spanning
ft <- add_header_row(
  ft,
  values    = c("", "AKI", "Sepsis", "AKI/sepsis"),
  colwidths = c(1, 3, 3, 3)
)

ft <- merge_h(ft, part = "header")
ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 11, part = "all")
ft <- align(ft, part = "header", align = "center")
ft <- align(ft, j = "Year", part = "body", align = "left")
ft <- align(ft, j = num_cols, part = "body", align = "right")
ft <- padding(ft, padding = 3, part = "all")
ft <- autofit(ft)

# ---------------- 4) export to Word ----------------
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Table. Annual percent change (APC) by condition and age group, 2010–2025",
    style = "heading 1"
  ) %>%
  body_add_par(
    "APC(t) = 100 × (AAMR_t / AAMR_{t−1} − 1). AAMR standardized to the 2000 U.S. standard population.",
    style = "Normal"
  ) %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = "tables/APC_table_by_condition_age_2010_2025.docx")
```

```{r}
p_apc_age <- ggplot(
  apc_plot_data,
  aes(x = Year, y = APC, color = age4)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "20–44" = "#1b9e77",
      "45–64" = "#d95f02",
      "65+"   = "#7570b3"
    ),
    name = "Age group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-over-year APC in Age-Adjusted Mortality Rates (2010–2025)",
    subtitle = "Computed from AAMR standardized to the 2000 U.S. population",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Annual percent change (APC, %)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
plot_apc_one_outcome <- function(df, outcome_name) {

  ggplot(
    df %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name),
    aes(x = Year, y = APC, color = age4)
  ) +

    # ---- COVID shading (behind data) ----
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 2019.5, xmax = 2022.5,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
      fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.18
    ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 2022.5, xmax = 2023.5,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
      fill = "grey40", alpha = 0.14
    ) +

    # ---- reference line ----
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey60") +

    # ---- APC lines ----
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function: build ONE disease APC plot (with repelled labels)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_apc_one_outcome <- function(df,
                                 outcome_name,
                                 label_years = 2020:2022,
                                 pandemic_alpha = 0.12,
                                 transition_alpha = 0.10) {

  df1 <- df %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name)

  label_df <- df1 %>%
    filter(Year %in% label_years, !is.na(APC), is.finite(APC)) %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("%.1f", APC))

  ggplot(df1, aes(x = Year, y = APC, color = age4, group = age4)) +

    # ---- background shading ----
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = 2019.5, xmax = 2022.5,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "grey70", alpha = pandemic_alpha) +
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = 2022.5, xmax = 2023.5,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "grey40", alpha = transition_alpha) +

    # ---- reference line ----
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey60") +

    # ---- lines + points ----
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(size = 1.9) +

    # ---- NON-overlapping numeric labels (pandemic years only) ----
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = lab),
      inherit.aes = TRUE,
      size = 3.0,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",

      # label placement tuning
      box.padding = 0.25,
      point.padding = 0.15,

      # subtle leader lines (kept light & thin)
      segment.color = "grey70",
      segment.size = 0.3,
      min.segment.length = 0,

      # ensure labels always appear
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      seed = 123,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "20–44" = "#1b9e77",
        "45–64" = "#d95f02",
        "65+"   = "#7570b3"
      ),
      name = "Age group"
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2025, 3)) +

    labs(
      x = "Year",
      y = "Annual percent change (APC, %)",
      caption = "Light grey: COVID-19 pandemic (2020–2022); darker grey: transition year (2023)."
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

## Joinpoint

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(broom)
  library(strucchange)
})

# --- APC + CI helper (your same) ---
apc_from_slope <- function(beta, se) {
  APC <- 100 * (exp(beta) - 1)
  LCL <- 100 * (exp(beta - 1.96 * se) - 1)
  UCL <- 100 * (exp(beta + 1.96 * se) - 1)
  tibble(APC = APC, LCL = LCL, UCL = UCL)
}

# --- long series helper (your same) ---
make_series_long <- function(rate_table_age, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {
  rate_table_age %>%
    mutate(Year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(YearKey)))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= year_min, Year <= year_max) %>%
    select(Year, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "series", values_to = "rate") %>%
    mutate(
      series = str_replace_all(series, "\\s+", ""),
      rate   = as.numeric(rate)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# A) Pick k_selected (number of joinpoints) by BIC using breakpoints()
# - fits: log(rate) ~ Year
# - chooses k in 0..max_k by minimum BIC
# - enforces minimum segment size via h = min_seg_n
# ============================================================
select_k_by_aicc_breakpoints <- function(series_df, max_k = 3, min_seg_n = 3) {

  df <- series_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rate), rate > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Year)

  if (nrow(df) < (2 * min_seg_n + 1)) {
    return(tibble(k_selected = 0L, join_years = list(integer(0))))
  }

  bp <- strucchange::breakpoints(log(rate) ~ Year, data = df, h = min_seg_n)

  # AIC for each k (0..K)
  aic_all <- stats::AIC(bp)

  # AICc correction: AIC + (2p(p+1))/(n-p-1)
  # p for k breaks in segmented regression on Year:
  # each segment has intercept+slope -> 2*(k+1)
  n <- nrow(df)
  k_max_possible <- length(aic_all) - 1L
  k_cap <- min(max_k, k_max_possible)

  aicc <- sapply(0:k_cap, function(k) {
    p <- 2 * (k + 1)
    aic_all[k + 1] + (2 * p * (p + 1)) / max(1, (n - p - 1))
  })

  k_sel <- which.min(aicc) - 1L

  if (k_sel == 0L) {
    join_years <- integer(0)
  } else {
    idx <- strucchange::breakpoints(bp, breaks = k_sel)$breakpoints
    join_years <- as.integer(df$Year[idx])
  }

  tibble(k_selected = as.integer(k_sel), join_years = list(join_years))
}
# build k_table for ALL series in rate_table_age
make_k_table <- function(rate_table_age, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025,
                         max_k = 3, min_seg_n = 3) {

  long <- make_series_long(rate_table_age, year_min, year_max)

  long %>%
    group_by(series) %>%
    group_modify(~ select_k_by_aicc_breakpoints(.x, max_k = max_k, min_seg_n = min_seg_n)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# B) Compute APC per segment given joinpoint years
# ============================================================
joinpoint_segments_traditional <- function(series_df, k_selected = 0, join_years = integer(0),
                                          year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  # keep for modeling (log needs >0)
  df_fit <- series_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rate), rate > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Year)

  # If no usable points, return the full window
  if (nrow(df_fit) < 3) {
    return(tibble(
      start_year = year_min, end_year = year_max,
      APC = NA_real_, LCL = NA_real_, UCL = NA_real_,
      k_selected = 0L
    ))
  }

  # segment cutpoints always anchored to full window
  if (is.null(join_years) || length(join_years) == 0 || k_selected == 0) {
    cuts <- c(year_min, year_max)
  } else {
    jy <- sort(unique(as.integer(join_years)))
    jy <- jy[jy > year_min & jy < year_max]
    cuts <- c(year_min, jy, year_max)
  }

  seg_ranges <- tibble(
    start_year = cuts[-length(cuts)],
    end_year   = cuts[-1]
  )

  purrr::pmap_dfr(seg_ranges, function(start_year, end_year) {

    seg_df <- df_fit %>% dplyr::filter(Year >= start_year, Year <= end_year)

    if (nrow(seg_df) < 3) {
      return(tibble(
        start_year = start_year, end_year = end_year,
        APC = NA_real_, LCL = NA_real_, UCL = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    fit <- lm(log(rate) ~ Year, data = seg_df)
    beta <- coef(fit)[["Year"]]
    se   <- summary(fit)$coefficients["Year", "Std. Error"]
    ci <- apc_from_slope(beta, se)

    tibble(
      start_year = start_year, end_year = end_year,
      APC = ci$APC, LCL = ci$LCL, UCL = ci$UCL
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(k_selected = as.integer(k_selected))
}
```

```{r}
make_joinpoint_results_table <- function(rate_table_age,
                                         year_min = 2010,
                                         year_max = 2025,
                                         max_k = 3,
                                         min_seg_n = 4) {

  long <- make_series_long(rate_table_age, year_min, year_max)

  # compute k_selected + join_years for each series
  k_table <- make_k_table(rate_table_age, year_min, year_max, max_k, min_seg_n)

  segs <- long %>%
    group_by(series) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(function(df_s) {

      s <- df_s$series[1]

      k_row <- k_table %>% filter(series == s)
      k <- ifelse(nrow(k_row) == 0, 0L, k_row$k_selected[1])
      jy <- if (nrow(k_row) == 0) integer(0) else k_row$join_years[[1]]

     joinpoint_segments_traditional(df_s, k_selected = k, join_years = jy,
                              year_min = year_min, year_max = year_max) %>%
        mutate(series = s) %>%
        select(series, k_selected, start_year, end_year, APC, LCL, UCL)
    })

  segs %>%
    mutate(
      Segment = ifelse(!is.na(start_year) & !is.na(end_year),
                       paste0(start_year, "–", end_year),
                       NA_character_),
      APC_CI = ifelse(is.na(APC),
                      "–",
                      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", APC, LCL, UCL))
    ) %>%
    arrange(series, start_year) %>%
    select(series, k_selected, Segment, APC_CI)
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(flextable)
  library(officer)
})

# ============================================================
# Text: model + segment explanation
# ============================================================
model_explain <- paste0(
  "Joinpoint-style trend analysis.\n",
  "We modeled annual age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMR) on the log scale using piecewise log-linear regression. ",
  "Within each segment, the model assumes a constant log-linear trend over time; the annual percent change (APC) ",
  "was derived from the segment-specific slope as APC = 100 × (exp(β) − 1), with 95% confidence intervals based on ",
  "the standard error of β.\n\n",
  "Model selection.\n",
  "The number of joinpoints (k_selected) was selected by Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) among models with 0 to ",
  3,
  " joinpoints, subject to a minimum of ",
  4,
  " years (points) per segment. ",
  "When k_selected = 0, the entire period (", 2010, "–", 2025,
  ") is summarized by a single APC. ",
  "When k_selected > 0, the period is partitioned into k_selected + 1 contiguous segments.\n\n",
  "Segment timespan.\n",
  "Each segment corresponds to a contiguous calendar-year interval (e.g., 2010–2016). ",
  "Segment boundaries are the joinpoint years implied by k_selected (the internal boundaries between adjacent segments). ",
  "Segments are reported in chronological order."
)

# ============================================================
# Helper: compute k_selected per series (for footnotes)
# ============================================================
k_map <- jp_results %>%
  distinct(series, k_selected)

k_footnote_text <- function(k_df) {
  # Example: "k_selected (BIC): AKI_20_44=2; AKI_45_64=1; ..."
  paste0(
    "k_selected (BIC-selected number of joinpoints): ",
    paste0(k_df$series, "=", k_df$k_selected, collapse = "; "),
    "."
  )
}

k_note_all <- k_footnote_text(k_map)

# ============================================================
# TABLE S2: Outcome × Age band (segment APC columns)
# ============================================================
table_S2 <- jp_results %>%
  tidyr::extract(
    col   = series,
    into  = c("Outcome", "AgeToken"),
    regex = "^(.*)_([^_]+)$",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = case_when(
      Outcome %in% c("AKI_Sepsis", "AKI/sepsis") ~ "AKI & sepsis",
      TRUE ~ Outcome
    ),
    AgeBand = case_when(
      AgeToken == "<20"   ~ "<20",
      AgeToken == "20_44" ~ "20–44",
      AgeToken == "45_64" ~ "45–64",
      AgeToken == "65+"   ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ AgeToken
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Outcome, AgeBand, Segment) %>%
  group_by(Outcome, AgeBand, series) %>%
  mutate(
    segment_number = row_number(),
    seg_col = paste0("Segment ", segment_number)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Outcome, AgeBand, series, seg_col, APC_CI) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seg_col, values_from = APC_CI) %>%
  arrange(Outcome, AgeBand)

# ============================================================
# TABLE S3: Full segment info (NO k_selected column)
# ============================================================
table_S3 <- jp_results %>%
  tidyr::extract(
    col   = Segment,
    into  = c("seg_start", "seg_end"),
    regex = "^(\\d{4})–(\\d{4})$",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_start = as.integer(seg_start),
    seg_end   = as.integer(seg_end)
  ) %>%
  group_by(series) %>%
  arrange(seg_start, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(segment_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(series, segment_number, Segment, seg_start, seg_end, APC_CI)

# ============================================================
# TABLE S4: Joinpoint years (NO k_selected column)
# ============================================================
table_S4 <- table_S3 %>%
  group_by(series) %>%
  summarise(
    joinpoint_years = list(seg_end[segment_number < max(segment_number)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    joinpoint_years = purrr::map_chr(
      joinpoint_years,
      ~ if (length(.x) == 0) "None" else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(series)

# ============================================================
# Flextable styling + table-specific footnotes
# ============================================================

ft_S2 <- flextable(table_S2) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  set_caption("Table S2. Joinpoint-style APC (95% CI) by outcome and age band.") %>%
  add_footer_lines(values = k_note_all)

ft_S3 <- flextable(table_S3) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  set_caption("Table S3. Segment time spans and APC (95% CI) for each series.") %>%
  add_footer_lines(values = k_note_all) %>%
  add_footer_lines(values = "Segment is the calendar-year interval for the fitted log-linear trend; APC (95% CI) is reported per segment.")

ft_S4 <- flextable(table_S4) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  set_caption("Table S4. Joinpoint years (internal boundaries) implied by the selected model.") %>%
  add_footer_lines(values = k_note_all) %>%
  add_footer_lines(values = "Joinpoint years correspond to the end year of each segment except the final segment (i.e., internal boundaries).")

# ============================================================
# Export Word doc
# ============================================================
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Statistical Appendix: Joinpoint-style Trend Modeling", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_par(model_explain, style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_S2) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_S3) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_S4)

print(doc, target = "Joinpoint_Tables_clean_footnotes.docx")
```

```{r}
apc_by_period <- function(df) {

  if (nrow(df) < 3) {
    return(tibble(APC = NA_real_, LCL = NA_real_, UCL = NA_real_))
  }

  fit <- lm(log(rate) ~ Year, data = df)

  beta <- coef(fit)[["Year"]]
  se   <- summary(fit)$coefficients["Year", "Std. Error"]

  APC <- 100 * (exp(beta) - 1)
  LCL <- 100 * (exp(beta - 1.96 * se) - 1)
  UCL <- 100 * (exp(beta + 1.96 * se) - 1)

  tibble(APC = APC, LCL = LCL, UCL = UCL)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# APC period results -> wide publication table -> Word export
# Assumes you already created:
#   apc_period_results with columns: series, period, APC, LCL, UCL, APC_CI
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(flextable)
  library(officer)
})

# ----------------------------
# 0) Define nice ordering + labels
# ----------------------------
period_levels <- c("Pre-pandemic (2010–2019)", "Pandemic (2020–2022)", "Post-pandemic (2023–2025)")
period_labels <- c("2010–2019", "2020–2022", "2023–2025")

# Optional: pretty series labels (edit as you like)
pretty_series <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace("^AKI/sepsis_", "AKI & Sepsis: ") %>%
    str_replace("^AKI_", "AKI: ") %>%
    str_replace("^Sepsis_", "Sepsis: ") %>%
    str_replace("_", " ") %>%
    str_replace(" 20 44$", "20–44") %>%
    str_replace(" 45 64$", "45–64") %>%
    str_replace(" 65\\+$", "≥65") %>%
    str_replace(" <20$", "<20")
}

# ----------------------------
# 1) Ensure the long table is clean + formatted text cell
# ----------------------------
apc_long_pub <- apc_period_results %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(period, levels = period_levels),
    series_label = pretty_series(series),
    APC_CI = ifelse(
      is.na(APC) | is.na(LCL) | is.na(UCL),
      "–",
      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", APC, LCL, UCL)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(series, series_label, period, APC_CI) %>%
  arrange(series_label, period)

# ----------------------------
# 2) Wide publication table (one row per series, one col per period)
# ----------------------------
apc_wide_pub <- apc_long_pub %>%
  select(series_label, period, APC_CI) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = period,
    values_from = APC_CI
  ) %>%
  # rename period columns to short journal headers
  rename_with(
    ~ period_labels[match(.x, period_levels)],
    .cols = all_of(period_levels)
  ) %>%
  rename(`Series` = series_label)

# ----------------------------
# 3) Flextable (journal-ish formatting)
# ----------------------------
ft <- flextable(apc_wide_pub)

ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 11, part = "all")
ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
ft <- align(ft, align = "left",  j = "Series", part = "all")
ft <- align(ft, align = "center", j = setdiff(names(apc_wide_pub), "Series"), part = "all")
ft <- valign(ft, valign = "center", part = "all")
ft <- padding(ft, padding = 3, part = "all")
ft <- autofit(ft)

# Optional: make header slightly larger
ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 12, part = "header")

# ----------------------------
# 4) Export to Word
# ----------------------------
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Table. Joinpoint-style annual percent change (APC) by period, 2010–2025",
    style = "heading 1"
  ) %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Values are APC% (95% CI) estimated from log-linear models fit within each period: 2010–2019, 2020–2022, and 2023–2025.",
    style = "Normal"
  ) %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = "tables/APC_period_wide_publication_table.docx")
```
